headline: Apple reports record quarterly revenue of $119.6 billion
summary: Apple Inc. reported its biggest quarter ever, driven by strong iPhone 15 sales and Services growth.

headline: Apple faces DOJ antitrust investigation over App Store
summary: The Justice Department has launched a formal investigation into Apple's App Store practices.

headline: Trump announces new tariffs on semiconductor imports from China
summary: President Trump announced a 35% tariff on semiconductor components imported from China.

headline: Pentagon awards Lockheed Martin $2.8B defense contract for F-35 upgrades
summary: The Department of Defense has awarded Lockheed Martin a multi-year contract for next-generation F-35 avionics.

headline: NVIDIA data center revenue surges 400% year-over-year on AI demand
summary: NVIDIA's data center segment generated $18.4 billion in revenue, driven by explosive AI chip demand.

headline: Elon Musk's DOGE targets $500B in federal spending cuts
summary: The Department of Government Efficiency led by Elon Musk has identified $500 billion in potential budget cuts.
